business_problem: The Bosch Group is a global leader in technology and services for the mobility, industrial technology, consumer goods, and energy and building technology sectors.
solution_summary: Bosch Mobility Platform & Solutions, a division of Bosch Mobility focused on enabling sustainable transportation solutions for people and goods at an ecosystemic level, set out to address the growing demand for digital solutions in the logistics and transportation sectors. By deploying advanced technologies and platforms, the company enhances efficiency in cost management, operational visibility, and sustainability practices within these industries. In pursuit of this objective, Bosch Mobility Platform & Solutions successfully launched the Logistics Operating System (L.OS) platform in collaboration with AWS experts, including AWS Professional Services, AWS Enterprise Support, and AWS Training and Certification.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the supply-chain and logistics workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Q
solution_components.role: Assists teams and workflows that support the supply-chain and logistics workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Executes serverless processing and workflow glue for the supply-chain and logistics workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon API Gateway
solution_components.role: Exposes APIs that front the supply-chain and logistics workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Control Tower
solution_components.role: Standardizes account guardrails and landing-zone controls for the supply-chain and logistics workflows.
